evidence.detail: Exact-v308 rs/s/b/u extends JToggleButton, owns exactly ON/OFF ImageIcon state plus one conflict String, and configures a fixed 25px-width undecorated switch button.

Its List setter formats '
Plugin conflicts: ...' with comma/and joining, and tooltip text switches between 'Disable plugin' and 'Enable plugin' plus that conflict string.

RuneLite PluginToggleButton is method-for-method equivalent: switcher_on.png source icon, flipped/grayscaled OFF icon, conflictString state, updateTooltip(), and setConflicts(List<String>) formatting.
R488 ConfigPanel and PluginListItem use this class as the enable/disable toggle for plugin configuration rows.

proposals.note: Exact RuneLite source-name recovery for PluginToggleButton.
